title: Insulin Pump Basal Override Frequency
dataSources: Pump telemetry (`health:glucose`), lab results (`health:lab`), therapy sessions (`health:pt`), symptom diaries (`health:symptom`), care tasks (`health:ops`).
app: Chronic-condition self-management telemetry — insulin-pump events, A1c lab imports, physical-therapy rep logs, and symptom diaries — streamed to Splunk HEC via device exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=health:glucose pump_profile=* basal_override=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(basal_override="yes",1,0))) as matched by pump_profile
| eval a_basal_override_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_basal_override_pct
description: Measures the percentage of insulin-pump intervals that end with a basal override by pump profile.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which pump profile are helping or hurting insulin-pump intervals.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a basal override` on `health:glucose` events and summarize the hit rate by `pump_profile`.
visualization: Table of pump profile with percentage of insulin-pump intervals ending with a basal override.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces how often a basal override happens for each pump profile so you can see where insulin-pump intervals go smoothly or get stuck.
